name: Ken Nakagaki
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
fitReason: Concrete LLM-to-physical-robot authoring and human evaluation fit a CS researcher interested in grounded collaboration. The emphasis is interactive systems and creative tabletop robotics, rather than general-purpose manipulation policy training.

physicalEvidence.summary: Shape n’ Swarm (UIST 2025) uses five GPT-4o agents, speech input and custom control APIs to generate and execute motion scripts on physical toio tabletop robots. The paper details Bluetooth bridges, live position feedback and an 11-person study. Robot collisions and script/interpretation failures remain limitations. The 2026 penPal project adds a tendon-driven continuum drawing tool and 10-person co-creation study; it is physical HRI, without an asserted learned policy.
